votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: This bill generally bars members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks, and it requires public notice before they sell. A Yea passes it in the House. A Nay votes against passage.

votes.question: On Motion to Recommit — Stop Insider Trading Act (H R 7008)
votes.bill_title: Stop Insider Trading Act
votes.plain_language: The Stop Insider Trading Act would bar members of Congress and their spouses and dependent children from buying stocks and would require public notice before a sale. votes.plain_language: H.R. 5103 (Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act of 2025) establishes a commission in the executive branch to advise on certain criminal and immigration matters in the District of Columbia. A motion to recommit is the minority's last formal chance to send a bill back to committee before the passage vote. A Yea supports sending it back; a Nay keeps it on the floor for the passage vote.

votes.question: On Passage — Protecting Access for Hunters and Anglers Act (H R 556)
votes.bill_title: Protecting Access for Hunters and Anglers Act
votes.plain_language: This bill bars the Fish and Wildlife Service, the Bureau of Land Management, and the Forest Service from prohibiting or regulating the use of lead ammunition or tackle on federal land or water. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.
